title: jupyterlite-pdf-exporter
description: Settings for the JupyterLite PDF exporter. These control the look and feel of the exported PDFs via Pandoc template variable mappings.

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: The paper size of the exported PDF.

fontSize.title: Font size
fontSize.description: The base text size. Include the unit, for example "10pt" or "12pt". Leave empty to use the default.

margin.title: Margins
margin.description: The space around the page edges. Include the unit, for example "2cm". Leave a field empty to use the default for that side.

mainFont.title: Main font
mainFont.description: The body font. Only fonts bundled with the Typst compiler are available.

pageNumbers.title: Page numbers
pageNumbers.description: Whether to print page numbers in the footer.

tableOfContents.title: Table of contents
tableOfContents.description: Add a table of contents at the start of the document.

lineSpacing.title: Line spacing
lineSpacing.description: The spacing between lines, as a multiple of the normal spacing.

linkColor.title: Link color
linkColor.description: The color used for links, for example "blue" or "#1a73e8". Leave empty to use the default.
